title: 404 Page
description:
## Display a Friendly 404 Error Page for Missing or Broken Links

---

### <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

**As a** website visitor, **I want** to see a helpful and friendly page when I land on a broken or missing link (404 error), **So that** I understand that the page doesn't exist and can easily navigate back to the main content.

---

* **Design**

    * The page should follow the site's overall theme
    * Has Headline and Subline, can be changed by user
    * Include a button to product list with all products , can be changed by user
    * Has a theme dependent header image ([Find asstes here](https://www.figma.com/design/Zle03g3Z7ieN700SDq5j77/Component-Examples?node-id=1429-308738&t=vF1TziFkO1YsXgqq-4)), can be changed by user
    * Has a content section so the user can display product sliders and other content as they wish 
    
        * Watch [AMBIENDO sunny page example](https://www.figma.com/design/gDN7wlDFp5mwXQfRDhotzR/Ambiendo---sunny?node-id=204-52113&t=IFNnHLbSJgLr2OPS-4)
        
    
* **Error Code Display**

    * Include the actual HTTP status code "404" for transparency or technical clarity.
    
* **Logging**

    * The 404 event should be logged server-side (or to an analytics tool) for tracking broken links.
    
* **No Indexing**

    * The page should include meta tags (`noindex`) to prevent search engines from indexing the error page.
    
* Return HTTP status code `404`.
* Load within <2 seconds.
* Do not redirect automatically (unless redirecting to a customized 404 route).
* Compatible with all major browsers.
* Accessible (meets WCAG 2.1 AA standards).
summary: Friendly 404 error page with customizable messaging, CTA button, and content slots.
features: Content slots for product sliders and promotions
Server-side 404 event logging for broken link tracking
shortDescription: The 404 Page transforms broken link encounters into recovery opportunities by presenting a branded, helpful error experience. It displays customizable headline and subline messaging alongside a theme-dependent header image, with a prominent call-to-action button directing visitors to the product catalog. Flexible content slots enable merchants to display product sliders or promotional content that may recapture visitor interest. Server-side logging tracks 404 events for broken link analysis while noindex meta tags prevent search engine indexing of error pages.
